Ticket:
Confused about form validation error when publishing intake questionnaire

Hi there, I'm really scratching my head over the questionnaire builder we use for pre-visit forms. I tried putting together a new health history questionnaire for our patients to fill out online before coming in, but every time I hit the publish button, it throws up some strange validation error on the phone number field that I just can't figure out. I've tried deleting the field and adding it back, changing the formatting requirements, and even retyping the whole question text, but it keeps giving me the same red warning triangle without explaining what's actually wrong with it. Could someone please take a look at our setup and tell me what field property I'm messing up so we can get this questionnaire live for next week's appointments?
